title: DIFFLET: A Fast Inference Engine for Diffusion Transformer Models on AWS Trainium
abstract: arXiv:2610.23047v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On AWS Trainium2, every component of a diffusion model runs as a program compiled ahead of time for fixed shapes, while pipelines differ across models, prompt lengths across requests, and caching decisions across denoising steps. We present Difflet, a serving engine in which five model pipelines share one compilation backend, joint attention is split across cores by attention head, and a host controller decides at each denoising step whether to run the denoiser or reuse its earlier output. A small probe program computes the caching signal on the device and returns one number per step, and a resident model process keeps every program loaded across requests. Across five image and video model families, fused attention accelerates denoiser steps by 1.2-4.3x over the same framework using PyTorch/XLA attention, and at 32.8k visual tokens it is the only attention that compiles. On four of the five models, resident serving is 1.5-3.4x faster t

translated_title: DIFFLET：AWS Trainium 上扩散 Transformer 模型的快速推理引擎
translated_abstract: 在 AWS Trainium2 上，扩散模型的每个组件都以针对固定形状预先编译的程序形式运行，而流水线在不同模型之间各不相同，提示词长度在不同请求之间各不相同，缓存决策在不同去噪步骤之间各不相同。我们提出了 Difflet——一种服务引擎，其中五个模型流水线共享同一个编译后端，联合注意力按注意力头在多个核心之间切分，主机控制器在每个去噪步骤决定是运行去噪器还是复用其先前的输出。一个小型探针程序在设备上计算缓存信号并每步返回一个数值，一个常驻模型进程使所有程序在请求之间保持加载状态。在五个图像和视频模型家族中，融合注意力使去噪器步骤相比使用 PyTorch/XLA 注意力的同一框架加速 1.2-4.3 倍，并且在 32.8k 视觉 token 规模下，它是唯一能够完成编译的注意力实现。在五个模型中的四个上，常驻服务快 1.5-3.4 倍（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: Difflet 是面向 AWS Trainium 的扩散 Transformer 服务引擎，通过五个流水线共享统一编译后端、按注意力头切分的融合注意力以及基于设备端探针的逐步缓存决策，将去噪步骤加速 1.2-4.3 倍，常驻服务速度提升 1.5-3.4 倍。
